claims.text: The hotel is set in the building of the Louvre Post Office.

findings.quote: nestled in the iconic building of the Louvre Post Office

claims.text: The building dates back to 1888 and was the city's first 24-hour post office.

findings.quote: the hotel is located inside a Haussmanian building dating back to 1888 that was the city’s first (and only) 24-hour post office

claims.text: The hotel is in Paris's 1st arrondissement, a stone's throw from the Louvre and the Palais Royal.

findings.quote: A luxury hotel in the heart of the 1st Arrondissement
a stone’s throw from the Louvre and the Palais Royal

claims.text: The Bourse de Commerce and the Samaritaine are also a stone's throw from the hotel.

findings.quote: a stone’s throw from the Louvre Museum, the Bourse de Commerce and the Samaritaine

claims.text: Rooms are dressed in walnut woodwork, warm velvet and bespoke zelliges, in a setting inspired by Art Nouveau.

findings.quote: dressed in walnut woodwork, warm velvet and bespoke zelliges. Ultimate comfort is combined with refined design, in a setting inspired by Art Nouveau

claims.text: Most rooms and suites have terraces or balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and monuments.

findings.quote: the majority of which feature terraces or balconies offering spectacular views of Parisian rooftops and iconic monuments

claims.text: Garden View rooms and suites have an outdoor space overlooking the hotel's suspended garden.

findings.quote: The spacious rooms and suites offer an outdoor space overlooking the suspended garden

claims.text: The 150-square-metre wellness area has two treatment cabins, a sauna with views over Paris and a fitness room.

findings.quote: an exclusive 150 m² wellness area featuring two treatment cabins, a sauna with views over Paris and a fitness room

claims.text: La Plume is a rooftop restaurant with a tree-lined terrace and views of Saint-Eustache church and the Eiffel Tower.

findings.quote: La Plume, a panoramic rooftop restaurant
Its tree-lined terrace and breathtaking views of Saint-Eustache church and the Eiffel Tower

claims.text: Solar panels produce part of the hotel's hot water.

findings.quote: the production of part of its hot water by solar panels

claims.text: The hotel was founded by French entrepreneur Laurent Taieb.

findings.quote: Founded by French entrepreneur Laurent Taïeb

claims.text: There are no steps, and all rooms, restaurants and lounges are reachable by elevator.

findings.quote: There are no steps, and all rooms, restaurants, and lounges are reachable by elevator.

claims.text: The ROOF rooftop covers 1,000 square metres, set among cherry trees and lush greenery.

findings.quote: the ROOF rooftop covers 1,000 m². Nestled between cherry trees and lush vegetation

claims.text: The rooftop is reserved for hotel guests during the day and opens to all in the evening for cocktails.

findings.quote: Reserved during the day for hotel guests, in the evening it becomes a convivial place open to all, perfect for sipping cocktails

claims.text: The 130-square-metre Penthouse is designed like a Parisian apartment suspended above the city.

findings.quote: a 130m² Penthouse, designed like a Parisian apartment suspended above the city

claims.text: Rooms and suites offer panoramic views over Paris, including the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre.

findings.quote: offering panoramic views over the whole city of Paris, including the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre

claims.text: Some 800 pieces of mail art hang throughout the hotel.

findings.quote: such as 800 pieces of mail art hung throughout

claims.text: In the evening the rooftop is open to the public, not only to hotel guests.

findings.quote: Reserved during the day for hotel guests, in the evening it becomes a convivial place open to all

claims.text: The wellness area is 150 square metres, with two treatment cabins.

findings.quote: an exclusive 150 m² wellness area featuring two treatment cabins
